verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a shipping in-product AI layer, Ramp Intelligence. It attaches policy-grounded recommended actions to every spend request, scans transactions in real time for anomalies and fraud, and auto-codes expenses and drafts memos (the CLI also exposes memo-suggestions). Together these are AI suggestions and flags generated from the user's own data. Missing for 10: in-product analytical insights such as spend trends or forecasting (documented only via external assistants over MCP), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of these suggestions.
